content.summary: A star pear becomes a golden tea through one irreversible proof chain. Preserve the five causal invariants and terminal proof while replacing every source-specific surface.

quick_start.input_format: One ingredient identity remains traceable. + Each irreversible operation causes the next state. + Tools and containers stay causally registered. + One viscosity proof precedes serving. + The final hero frame reunites source ingredient, process and serving.
quick_start.recommended_input: Open one fictional amber star pear with a single clean knife cut in a frontal studio close-up. Add three ice cubes and one measured stream of pale tea, then blend into a golden opaque drink. Hold the adult maker, opened pear, mixer and finished glass beneath the exact line ONE CUT / GOLDEN READY.
